added_failures_note: Completed comparable source suite arms: baseline 1 failure, head 0 failures; set difference is empty.

assertion_audit.scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap/test_: The wide-wall vertex assertion fails if capacity fitting again produces no valid vertices.
The finite winding assertion fails if the record yields no boundary measurement; the accepted-label set is broad, and the lattice-16 note only echoes the input resolution.
assertion_audit.scripts/prototypes/tcv_liuqe_known_answe: A census missing the saddle must refuse; returning limited, a resolution or a certified certificate makes the test fail.
The true winding and certified result fail if the analytic field cannot close; index_sum == 1 is circular because 1 was passed to coverage_certificate.
A cancelled missing extremum-saddle pair must still refuse; ignoring empty-cell enclosure makes line 145 fail, as the recorded negative control demonstrates.
A constant zero-gradient cell must remain unresolved and unoccupied; certifying it as empty makes the assertions fail.
A nonstationary invalid axis slot must refuse; accepting it as limited or reporting a certified read fails.
A true one-maximum field must certify and read limited; refusing it or giving another label fails.
The known annular domain has equal nonzero outer and obstacle windings and total zero; adding rather than subtracting the obstacle fails the zero-total and certification assertions.
A critical point on the sampled loop must make winding unreliable; accepting it fails.
The selected real LIUQE slice has no stored X-point and must read limited with zero uncleared cells; a refusal or other label fails.
The analytic two-maxima field gives winding one; an incorrect winding or a certificate that accepts the deliberately wrong index two makes these assertions fail.

findings.text: blocking: Relative axis position gaps use axis-to-nearest-X distance and become undefined for limited LIUQE slices even though their boundary outlines exist; the source done_when requires a relative axis-to-boundary gap for each scored slice.

follow-on: The second CLI sweep duplicates measure.py:205-260, which already opens LIUQE, measures slices and writes rows; the two drivers have different defaults and failure records, so future scores can diverge.

follow-on: The index_sum == 1 part of this assertion only echoes the 1 supplied to coverage_certificate on line 125, so it stays true when the coverage refusal regresses; the independently computed total and refusal assertions carry the real guard.
follow-on: Checking that the note contains lattice 16 only echoes the resolution 16 passed to _row on line 61; it cannot show that coverage certification ran or reached the expected result.
